text.en:
Order No. 4, dated July 19, 1946,, as amended, are hereby transferred
to, and shall hereafter be exercised by, the Import Control Board.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of August, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
EMILIO ABeLLo
Executive Secretary
